dataset.name: EuroSAT
dataset.description: Official EuroSAT v2 RGB JPEG variant from Zenodo record 7711810: 27,000 Sentinel-2 land-cover images in ten original class folders. This RGB variant is distinct from the 13-band multispectral archive. The preview interleaves classes to show ten examples per class.

rights.attribution: EuroSAT (c) Helber et al.; dataset MIT. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2015–2018.
rights.note: Exact per-image capture years are absent; the 2015–2018 source-year range is inferred from Sentinel-2A launch and the 2018 v2 release. The review covers only the 100-image RGB preview in reports/eurosat-publication-review.md.

sampling.population: official EuroSAT v2 RGB, 27,000 class-folder JPEGs
sampling.selection_note: 100 real original RGB JPEGs: first ten round-robin examples from each of ten original class folders. Not random or complete.
